expect.title: Road Closure
expect.body: New Zealand often experiences road closures. Alternative routes may take more time, so please follow the Driver Guide on timing management in order to arrive on time.

expect.title: Credit/Debit Card
expect.body: A refundable security deposit may be required by certain hotels at check-in, payable by Credit/Debit card.

expect.title: Restaurant
expect.body: Please note that during winter, many restaurants may open later in the day and close earlier than usual.

expect.title: Hotel Hopping
expect.body: 8 times Hotel Transfer. Please pack lightly for easier hotel transfer.

expect.title: Airport Transfer
expect.body: Please bring max 1 luggage for 1 pax as it will affect car capacity.

expect.title: Exclude Meals
expect.body: Exclude breakfast, lunch and dinner unless mentioned in itinerary.

expect.title: Driver Guide
expect.body: Malay/English speaking driver cum guide (Max 10 hours daily).

expect.title: Car Parking
expect.body: Parking fees for locations listed in the itinerary are included. Please note that parking at any additional locations may incur extra charges.

expect.title: Long Haul Road Trip
expect.body: Some locations might require a 4-5 hour road trip. Toilet breaks & coffee breaks will be tailored as required.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
Full payment has to be made 45 days prior arrival.
The price is for 2@3 person per room (Additional RM2500/person for Single Room).
Itinerary and price are subject to change without prior notices.
Late Booking Surcharge will apply for bookings made less than 45 days before the departure date.
Hotel name & location will be confirmed at least 45 days before departure date.
Itinerary or tour will start from Christchurch Airport & ends at Christchurch Airport.
This package is valid until 31st March 2027 travel period.

deposit.text: prior to departure for full payment

seasons.label: Last Minute Surcharge
seasons.period: Booking less than 45 days before departure date
seasons.rate: 2 pax: Additional RM1500 per pax · 3 pax & above: Additional RM1000 per pax
